summary: This component renders a small icon badge that indicates a post was written with AI assistance. It displays an SVG icon with the label 'AI Assisted' inside a styled container, and includes a tooltip that appears on hover.

explanations.4: The function returns React.JSX.Element, which is TypeScript's way of saying this function creates and returns a piece of React UI that can be displayed on a page.
explanations.7: className applies CSS styles from the imported stylesheet to this div, similar to how you'd use class attributes in HTML but with module-scoped styles to avoid naming conflicts.
explanations.16: strokeCurrentColor means the SVG will use whatever text color is currently active, so it automatically adapts if you change the text color in CSS.
explanations.17: strokeWidth='2' controls how thick the lines of the SVG drawing are, in this case 2 units thick.
